identity.title: Detailed Radial Scale Height Profile of Dust Grains as Probed by Dust Self-scattering in HL Tau

paper_type_evidence.quote: The details of the observations and the data reductions are presented in (cite: Stephens2023).
In this work, we model the high-resolution polarization observations towards the HL Tau system, focusing on the polarization from dust self scattering that dominates the inner disk and rings.

question.value: Infer the detailed radial dust scale height profile and its implications for dust settling and turbulence in HL Tau.

evidence.quote: By analyzing the dust self-scattering signal, we can infer the detailed structure of the disk and the processes that govern dust settling, which is the goal of this paper.

why_this_method.value: Compare polarization at the same radius to constrain vertical structure while fixing the dust model

evidence.quote: We fix the dust model, as the aim of this paper is to study the effect of dust vertical distributions on the detailed structures of scattering-induced polarization.

how_they_decided_enough.value: Inner-disk asymmetry saturates at H/R ≥ 0.15; first-ring models at 0.15 and 0.2 resemble 0.1; use 1.6 × 10^9 photons for high signal-to-noise

evidence.quote: For $H/R\ge 0.15$, the near-far side asymmetry is roughly saturated and does not increase any more.
We also experiment with models with $H/R=0.15,$ and 0.2. The results are similar to $H/R=0.1$.
For each radiation transfer simulation, we use $1.6\times 10^9$ photons to obtain a polarization image with a high signal-to-noise ratio.

referee_caveats_inferred: The Discussion reverses the inner-disk and first-ring inequalities relative to the modeling sections and Summary; use the latter for answer keys.
The printed ring equation has an exponent of −2 despite being described as Gaussian; implementation needs clarification.
The first ring is described as approximately 20 au, while Table 1 places its center at 24 au.
The body and Summary give approximate but distinct inner turbulence values and radius labels; preserve both rather than treating them as exact equivalents.
No likelihood, confidence intervals or quantitative detection threshold accompanies the H/R constraints.
Fixed grain properties and the phenomenological gap Gaussian limit the uniqueness of the inferred thickness.
A large photon count is reported, but numerical grid and photon-convergence tests are absent.

missing_for_reproduction: Stephens2023 observation, calibration and imaging details, plus the exact combined image products.
Runnable RADMC-3D and bhmie inputs, software versions and complete opacity construction.
Clarification of the printed ring profile and the unspecified inner-disk characteristic radius.
Exact image registration, ring masks, extraction sectors and uncertainty calculations.
A quantitative comparison statistic and detection criterion for the aspect-ratio limits.
Machine-readable final radial scale height profile and model/residual images.
An explicit statement of data public availability and any released analysis code.
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Raw-data volume cannot be estimated from the supplied setup; modeling is computationally substantial at 300 × 256 × 256 cells and 1.6 × 10^9 photons per simulation.
reproducibility.score_reason: On a 0–10 scale: project IDs, image properties, model ingredients and numeric targets are given, but reduction details are inherited and runnable inputs, several model settings and statistical criteria are missing.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Main results are numeric, but public availability is not stated and the supplied recipe lacks essential reduction and model implementation details.
